start.name: North Egmont road end
start.quote: The track starts in North Egmont.

via.name: Tahurangi Lodge
via.quote: The only toilet is 100 m below Tahurangi Lodge

via.name: numbered marker poles to the summit
via.quote: Above Tahurangi Lodge, numbered marker poles lead to the summit

ways.distance: 6.3 km one way return via same track
evidence: The track starts in North Egmont.
Turn onto Egmont Road and follow this up the mountain to North Egmont.
Above Tahurangi Lodge, numbered marker poles lead to the summit and give you an indication of how far you have to go.

access_points.name: Stratford Plateau car park on Pembroke Road
access_points.quote: starting the trail from the Stratford Plateau car park on Pembroke Road, Stratford
access_points.onto: Summit Climb, via the ski field toward Tahurangi Lodge

doubts: Shape is out and back from DOC's distance '6.3 km one way return via same track'; the text itself does not describe the descent route. The start is taken as the North Egmont road end (F1, where the North Egmont Summit Track meets Egmont Road), since the text names a North Egmont road end, but the feature's track name is not the Summit Climb's name, so this is fairly but not fully certain. Tahurangi Lodge has no ref in the packet and the text does not say it has bunks; it is listed as a hut because the climb passes it and it is a lodge. The Stratford Plateau car park start joins the Summit Climb near Tahurangi Lodge across the ski field; it has no feature in the packet, so it is an access point with ref null. The ski field route is not walked by the main way.
